method: Inspected transactional migration, exact frozen input persistence, revision checks, latest-round guard, checkpoint history, backup error cleanup and genuine child-process exit tests. Three behavioral failures were confirmed and repaired. This reviews only the completed storage slice.
impact_assessment: P00/P01 accepted evidence and protected baseline are retained unchanged. New persistence checks run beside foundation/control regressions. The current source needs fresh native reports; full P02 remains incomplete regardless of suite success.

findings.reason: Older-round intent is rejected before any persistent write.
Checkpoint must match the complete latest committed event history.
Backup destination connection is always closed before failed output cleanup.
Native evidence is exempt from Git newline normalization; actual staging/checkout roundtrip preserves exact CRLF bytes.
Real Windows run exposed three test-helper connection leaks; explicit closing preserves assertions and permits cleanup. Fresh Windows/Linux verification is required.
